# Pasta, rice and soups
[color=#B7ABA0]THE WASTELAND TABLE / CHAPTER 04[/color]
## Boiled spaghetti
[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x stick of butter + 15u razorgrain flour + 6u raw egg.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 15 seconds.

[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x boiled spaghetti + 2 x wild tato.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 10 seconds.

[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x boiled spaghetti + 1 x stick of butter.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 10 seconds.

[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x boiled spaghetti + 1 x wild onion + 1 x wild carrot + 1 x wild maize + 1 x chicken egg.

[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x bowl + 15u oats + 10u water.

[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x bowl + 15u rice + 10u water.
[bold]Cook:[/bold] 15 seconds.

[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x bowl + 15u rice + 10u brahmin milk + 5u sugar.

[bold]Ingredients:[/bold] 1 x boiled rice + 3 x raw rad cutlet.
